# The archive label conversion needs its later XHTML consumer repair

The initial HTML conversion defines -label Fluent values and migration targets but leaves four XHTML consumers on *-name2 IDs. The later one-file follow-up changes those consumers to the actual -label IDs. The fixed accepted markup and resource match, and default-folder translator comments remain. Keep the original mismatch and separate repair visible; no localization lookup or native failure was executed.

Scope: Archive preview Fluent consumer alignment.
